headline: Earnings soften year over year and fall further sequentially
summary_short: Sun reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥69.72, down 12.6% y/y from ¥79.74.
summary_long: EPS of ¥69.72 fell 12.6% year-over-year from ¥79.74, and fell 38.6% sequentially from ¥113.49 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
